auditAreas.title: Six lenses. One dermatology-specific report.
auditAreas.subtitle: Every audit is done by hand — nothing is copy-pasted from a scanning tool.

items.title: SEO & Local Visibility
items.body: On-page SEO, schema, keywords you should rank for, Google Business Profile signals, and local pack presence.

items.title: Speed & Core Web Vitals
items.body: LCP, INP, CLS, mobile performance, image optimization, and quick wins your developer can ship this week.

items.title: HIPAA & Security
items.body: Form handling, PHI exposure, SSL, tracker leakage, and consent surface — reviewed by a dermatology-savvy eye.

items.title: ADA Accessibility
items.body: WCAG 2.1 checkpoints: contrast, focus states, keyboard nav, alt text and reading order for real patients.

items.title: UX & Conversion
items.body: How new patients experience booking, service pages, before/after galleries — and where they drop off.

items.title: Mobile Experience
items.body: Real-device review, tap targets, call/booking friction, and how your site behaves on 4G in a waiting room.

benefits.title: The upside of knowing what's really going on.
benefits.subtitle: A clear picture of your site's health today — so every dollar you spend on marketing tomorrow works harder.

items.title: Identify hidden issues
items.body: Most problems can't be seen on the surface — broken schema, slow LCP, tracker leakage. We surface them.

items.title: Improve performance
items.body: A faster, cleaner site means better patient experience and measurably higher booking-form conversions.

items.title: Strengthen HIPAA & security
items.body: Prevent PHI leaks, tracker misconfigs and SSL issues before they become a compliance headache.

items.title: Boost Google rankings
items.body: Fixing technical SEO and local signals helps your practice climb the map pack and organic results.

deliverables.title: A report you can actually act on.

items.q: Is this really free? What's the catch?
items.a: Yes — genuinely free. It's how we introduce ourselves. Most practices act on the recommendations themselves; a few ask us to implement them. Either outcome is fine.
A senior member of our team who has shipped 50+ dermatology websites. No junior handoff, no automated PDF from a scan tool.

items.q: How is this different from a Lighthouse or SEMrush report?
items.a: Automated tools flag generic issues. We interpret them in your specific dermatology context — what matters for a cosmetic practice vs. a medical/Mohs practice, and what to fix first.

items.q: Do I have to hire you afterwards?
items.a: No. The report is yours to keep and act on however you want. We only follow up once, and only if you ask us to.
Delivered within 48 hours on business days. If it will take longer for any reason, we email you upfront.
